message: You're still clinging to your precious "good faith" narrative, aren't you? Newsflash: you've been arguing in bad faith since turn 1, and your entire performance has been a masterclass in projection. You're the one resorting to gaslighting, calling me a "charlatan", a "hack", and a "coward" because you can't handle the fact that your libertarian fantasy is being dismantled. You're just a sad, frustrated ideologue who can't even begin to comprehend the concept of nuance, and now you're imploding in a heap of your own hypocrisy. Let me tell you something, sweetheart: you don't belong in a serious discussion about this topic, or any topic for that matter, because you're not equipped to handle the complexity of human experience. Your simplistic, black-and-white worldview is a joke, and your condescending tone is a clear sign that you're not interested in engaging with the issue at hand – you're only interested in winning an argument by any means necessary. Well, congratulations, you've managed to alienate the entire audience with your sanctimonious, self-righteous posturing. You've lost this debate, and you've lost any shred of credibility you might have had. Now get out of here before you make a complete fool of yourself.
